title: Robert Maxwell PROMIS software sold to national labs

tellings.quote: this sort of promise software. Are you familiar with this that Robert Maxwell, you know, who obviously is intimately connected with Epstein, sold to our national labs

plain: Jesse Michels says that the British publisher Robert Maxwell, whom he calls closely tied to the financier Jeffrey Epstein, sold a piece of software called PROMIS to US national laboratories, the government's big science and weapons research centres. Michels raises it himself, as a question to Bill Richardson, a former US Secretary of Energy, asking whether he knew of it; if true, it would mean software from a well-connected outsider sat inside sensitive labs.
